items.original:
FINAL PREPARATIONS: SEASSE

The Void Warp Relay calibration is complete. Helldivers are advised: T-Minus 1 Hour to Landfall.

The path to to Seasse, the Void source planet, is fully stabilized. All Helldivers are ordered to conclude preparatory operations. Ready for imminent deployment into the heart of the anomaly, and the lawful eradication of the Void.

For Super Earth.
items.translated:
最终准备：西斯

寂域曲速继电器校准完成。建议绝地潜兵：倒计时1小时着陆。

通往寂域源行星西斯的道路已经完全稳定。所有绝地潜兵被命令完成准备行动。准备立即部署到异常的中心，合法铲除寂域。

超级地球。

items.original:
T-MINUS 3 HOURS: SEASSE

Final systems checks are underway across the vanguard fleet. The Void Warp Relay is approaching the terminal energy density required for transit on schedule.

High Command reminds all personnel to report to battle stations and immediately report any unapproved physical mutations. Continue to prepare for imminent, synchronized FTL transit.
items.translated:
倒计时3小时：西斯

先锋舰队正在进行最终系统检查。寂域曲速继电器正在接近按计划运输所需的终端能量密度。

最高指挥部提醒所有人员向作战站报告，并立即报告任何未经批准的物理突变。继续为即将到来的同步FTL运输做准备。

items.original:
T-MINUS 6 HOURS: SEASSE

The Void Warp Relay has entered its final power-up sequence. The jump corridor to the Void source planet will open in exactly six hours.

Logistics teams will soon finalize the distribution of advanced arsenal augmentations across all participating destroyer hulls. Ensure all standard-issue compliance tools are fully serviced.
items.translated:
T分钟6小时：西斯

寂域曲速继电器已进入最后一次通电序列。通往寂域源行星的跳跃走廊将在六小时后开放。

后勤团队将很快完成在所有参与的驱逐舰船体上分配先进武器库的工作。确保所有标准问题合规工具都得到全面服务。

items.original:
T-MINUS 7 HOURS: SEASSE

The Void Warp Relay is nearing optimal calibration. The jump to Seasse, the Void source planet will commence in 7 hours.

Tactical augmentations procured by the Helldivers during this preparatory phase are currently being processed by fleet logistics. The Illuminate will soon face the inescapable reality of Managed Democracy.

VOID PLANET TRIANGULATED

UVP DELTA is now reachable, thanks to Helldiver efforts. All detected planet within the Void are now accessible, with the exception of one, which is believed to lie at the Void's astro-temporal center.

MAJOR ORDER WON

The Helldivers’ investigative charting of the Void's initial layer was a masterclass in conquering the unknown. 

Data extracted from the three initial worlds allowed SEAF navigation arrays to successfully calibrate despite the unlawful spacetime anomalies, narrowing search parameters for the hidden Illuminate source planet. As such, the offensive toward the enemy's central base of operations remains on schedule, and with immediate SEAF support available.
items.translated:
重要指令已完成

绝地潜兵对寂域初始层域的探索性测绘，堪称征服未知领域的典范之作。

从三个初始世界提取的数据，使超级地球武装部队（SEAF）的导航阵列得以在非法时空异常中成功校准，缩小了对光能者隐藏母星的搜索范围。因此，针对敌方核心作战基地的攻势仍按计划推进，且即刻可获得SEAF的支援。

items.original:
ARSENAL AUGMENTATION

To aid their valiant efforts, all Helldiver deployments on UVP ALPHA will be augmented with the Shield Generator Pack Stratagem for the next 24 hours.
items.translated:
军械强化

为助力英勇作战，未来24小时内，所有在UVP阿尔法部署的绝地潜兵将配备护盾生成器背包战略配备。

items.original:
SEASSE LOCATED

The body at the Void barycenter closely matches known properties of the planet Seasse, the first to fall into the Void. This confirms theories on approaching the Void's origin. 

Nearly enough data has been gathered to allow travel to Seasse. The Helldivers are ordered to take all necessary measures to hasten the final stages of research.
items.translated:
海域定位

寂域质心处的天体与已知行星西阿斯（首颗坠入寂域的行星）的特性高度吻合。这证实了关于接近寂域起源的理论。

已收集的数据几乎足以支持前往西阿斯的航行。绝地潜兵奉命采取一切必要措施，加速研究最终阶段的进程。

items.original:
VOID PLANET TRIANGULATED

Coordinates for HYDROBIUS have been determined within .01% error, following extensive Void material analysis. Operations on the planet may now commence.

Matter from planets within the Void has been discovered to posses varying levels of a novel property similar in principle to radiation. Higher levels of radiation are believed to indicate longer exposure to the Void, and thus point towards the Void's origin.
items.translated:
寂域星球三角定位完成

经过对寂域物质的广泛分析，哈卓毕亚斯的坐标已确定，误差在0.01%以内。该星球上的行动现已可以展开。

发现寂域内行星的物质具有一种新型属性的不同程度，该属性在原理上与辐射相似。据信，辐射水平越高，表明暴露于寂域的时间越长，从而指向寂域的起源。

items.original:
VOID PLANET TRIANGULATED

Helldiver actions within the Void have enabled the triangulation of UVP BETA, which may now be accessed. The Helldivers are ordered to support further data gathering efforts in order to support continued progress toward's the Void's center.
items.translated:
寂域行星三角定位完成

绝地潜兵在寂域内的行动已成功实现对UVP贝塔的三角定位，该区域现已可进入。绝地潜兵奉命支援进一步的数据收集工作，以支持向寂域中心持续推进的进程。
